summary: The index is an equal-dollar weighted Index designed to track the performance of 10 highly-traded growth stocks of technology and tech-enabled companies. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments, such as swap agreements, securities of the index, and exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that track the index, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to the index, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
